# Villa Cypris on Screen: Mortelle Randonnée and the Darker Riviera

The French Riviera has always made an excellent setting for stories about people with something to hide.

Its elegant hotels, secluded villas and magnificent coastal views suggest money, privacy and the freedom to live almost any life one chooses.

But those qualities can also make it a convincing setting for psychological suspense.

In Claude Miller's 1983 film Mortelle Randonnée, known internationally as Deadly Circuit or Deadly Run, the Riviera becomes part of a journey through obsession, deception and murder.

The film stars Michel Serrault as a private detective known as L'Œil, or “The Eye”.

He's following a mysterious young woman played by Isabelle Adjani.

She moves between identities, relationships and luxurious environments, leaving behind a trail of violence.

The detective gradually becomes convinced that the woman might be his long-lost daughter.

His investigation turns into something far more personal.

Among the film's memorable locations is Villa Cypris, an extraordinary early twentieth-century property on the rocky coast of Roquebrune-Cap-Martin, near Menton.

The villa's brick arcades, richly decorated architecture and gallery overlooking the Mediterranean provide an ideal setting for the film's mixture of elegance and unease.

And unlike some inaccessible Riviera film locations, one of its most distinctive architectural features can be appreciated from an authorised public coastal path, subject to the path being open.

This guide explores the film, the real building behind the screen and how to experience the location respectfully.

It is deliberately centred on one confirmed historic villa, rather than inventing a long itinerary of unrelated attractions.

# Villa Cypris à l'écran : Mortelle Randonnée et la Riviera inquiétante

Les hôtels élégants, les villas isolées et les vues méditerranéennes évoquent l'argent, l'intimité et la liberté. Ils peuvent aussi former un décor de suspense. Dans Mortelle Randonnée, sorti en 1983, Claude Miller fait de la Riviera une étape d'un voyage marqué par les identités changeantes et l'obsession.

Michel Serrault joue L'Œil, un détective privé qui suit la mystérieuse jeune femme interprétée par Isabelle Adjani. Il croit reconnaître en elle sa fille disparue : l'enquête devient personnelle. Parmi les lieux du film figure Villa Cypris, sur le rivage rocheux de Roquebrune-Cap-Martin, près de Menton.

Ses arcades de brique et sa galerie au-dessus de la mer offrent un contraste entre beauté et inquiétude. On peut en apprécier certains éléments depuis le sentier public autorisé, si le tronçon est ouvert, sans pénétrer dans le domaine privé. Ce guide reste centré sur ce lieu documenté, sans inventer un circuit de scènes.

## 1. Discover the film: Mortelle Randonnée

Original title: Mortelle Randonnée

International titles: Deadly Circuit, Deadly Run

French theatrical release: 9 March 1983

Director: Claude Miller

Screenplay: Michel Audiard and Jacques Audiard, adapted from Marc Behm's novel Eye of the Beholder

Principal cast: Michel Serrault, Isabelle Adjani, Guy Marchand, Sami Frey, Stéphane Audran, Geneviève Page and Macha Méril

Cinematography: Pierre Lhomme

Music: Carla Bley

Genre: Psychological thriller / Crime drama

The film follows a private detective through a succession of European locations as he observes a young woman who repeatedly changes identity.

What begins as surveillance becomes an increasingly disturbing emotional relationship.

L'Œil is haunted by the disappearance of his daughter. The resemblance he perceives between the woman he follows and the child he lost begins to overwhelm his professional judgement.

The film combines crime and suspense with an exploration of grief, projection and emotional obsession.

### Why is the film unusual?

It's not simply a detective story about finding a murderer.

The audience knows much more about the young woman's behaviour than an ordinary whodunit might reveal at the beginning.

The tension comes from the relationship between observer and observed.

The detective becomes fascinated by someone he should be investigating objectively.

And the film moves through a succession of stylish European environments that contrast sharply with the violence and personal despair beneath the surface.

Claude Miller uses architecture, hotel interiors, gardens and private residences to reinforce that contrast.

### Different versions of the film

Official catalogues do not all describe the same edition. Quebec's classification register lists 120-minute and 96-minute editions, while the CNC record lists 101 minutes with a 1994 visa. Do not treat those records as one uniform running time.

That matters for anyone researching filming locations.

A timestamp taken from one edition may not identify the same scene in another.

For this guide, the villa's identity is supported by location records, but exact shot timestamps have not been independently verified against both versions.

### Where to watch

[Mortelle Randonnée — Cinémathèque française film record](https://www.cinematheque.fr/film/50171.html)

Use legitimate cinema, rental or disc catalogues to find an edition. The ARTE link in the supplied research could not be reliably opened at this check; no current streaming availability is confirmed. Availability depends on territory, licensing and the particular edition.

Ce n'est pas un simple jeu de recherche du coupable. Le spectateur connaît déjà certains actes de la jeune femme. La tension naît surtout du rapport entre celle qui est observée et celui qui perd sa distance. Les lieux raffinés contrastent avec la violence et le désarroi privés. L'analyse du décor proposée ici ne remplace pas un relevé plan par plan.

Les catalogues ne décrivent pas tous la même édition : le registre québécois distingue des versions de 120 et 96 minutes, tandis que la fiche CNC indique 101 minutes avec un visa de 1994. Consultez les catalogues légitimes de salles, location ou disques. ## 1. Scoprire Mortelle Randonnée

Titolo originale: Mortelle Randonnée. Titoli internazionali: Deadly Circuit e Deadly Run. Uscita francese: 9 marzo 1983. Regia: Claude Miller. Sceneggiatura: Michel Audiard e Jacques Audiard, dal romanzo Eye of the Beholder di Marc Behm. Con Michel Serrault, Isabelle Adjani, Guy Marchand, Sami Frey, Stéphane Audran, Geneviève Page e Macha Méril. Fotografia: Pierre Lhomme. Musica: Carla Bley.

Il detective attraversa diverse località europee seguendo una donna che cambia identità. La sorveglianza diventa un rapporto emotivo disturbante; la somiglianza immaginata con la figlia compromette il giudizio professionale. È un thriller psicologico su perdita, proiezione e ossessione, oltre che un'indagine.

### Perché è insolito?

Non si tratta soltanto di scoprire un assassino: lo spettatore conosce già alcuni comportamenti della donna. La tensione riguarda osservatore e osservata. Gli ambienti raffinati contrastano con violenza e disperazione. La lettura del paesaggio qui proposta non sostituisce un'analisi fotogramma per fotogramma.

### Edizioni diverse

I cataloghi non descrivono tutti la stessa versione: il registro del Québec elenca edizioni di 120 e 96 minuti, mentre la scheda CNC indica 101 minuti con visto del 1994. Non sono una durata unica. Un minutaggio può cambiare tra copie; le sequenze non sono state confrontate in tutte le edizioni.

### Dove vederlo?

Cercate copie legittime nei cataloghi di cinema, noleggio o dischi. La [scheda della Cinémathèque française](https://www.cinematheque.fr/film/50171.html) documenta il film, non uno streaming attuale. Il collegamento ARTE fornito non si è aperto in modo affidabile: nessuna disponibilità corrente è confermata. Contano territorio, diritti ed edizione.

## 2. Villa Cypris: the real house behind the fictional residence

Location: Avenue Douine, Roquebrune-Cap-Martin.

Villa Cypris stands within the historic Cap Martin estate, on the rocky Mediterranean coastline between Menton and Monaco.

It's an unusually distinctive building.

Its architecture combines pale stone, warm red brick, ornamental arches and decorative details influenced by Byzantine traditions.

The property belongs to the wave of ambitious private villas developed on Cap Martin in the early twentieth century.

But unlike the more conventional Belle Époque houses built nearby, Cypris has an architectural language that is immediately recognisable.

### Who commissioned it?

The villa was built shortly after 1904 for Madame Robert Douine, wife of the director of the Grands Magasins du Louvre department store in Paris.

The architect was Édouard Arnaud.

The surrounding gardens were designed by Raffaële Maïnella, an Italian painter and landscape designer born in Benevento in 1858.

The French Ministry of Culture identifies the villa as Byzantine-inspired and documents the elaborate garden composition.

### A protected historic monument

Villa Cypris was registered as a French historic monument on 19 September 1990.

Its protected elements include the buildings, entrance gates, pavilions, paths, stairs, pools, fountains, decorative structures and historic garden ornaments.

This heritage status recognises the importance of the property as an architectural and landscape ensemble.

It does not make the estate an ordinary public museum.

## 2. Villa Cypris : la vraie demeure derrière la fiction

Adresse patrimoniale : avenue Douine, Roquebrune-Cap-Martin. La villa appartient à l'histoire du domaine du Cap Martin, sur le littoral entre Menton et Monaco. Pierre claire, brique rouge, arcs et décors d'inspiration byzantine lui donnent une silhouette particulière parmi les résidences du début du XXe siècle.

### La commande et les créateurs

Le ministère de la Culture décrit une construction peu après 1904 pour Mme Robert Douine, épouse du directeur des Grands Magasins du Louvre à Paris. L'architecte est Édouard Arnaud ; les jardins sont une création de Raffaële Maïnella, peintre et paysagiste né à Bénévent en 1858.

### Un ensemble protégé

L'inscription aux monuments historiques date du 19 septembre 1990. Elle couvre la propriété dans son ensemble : bâtiments, portails, pavillons, jardins, allées, escaliers, pièces d'eau et ornements historiques. La protection reconnaît l'ensemble architectural et paysager ; elle ne transforme pas la villa en musée public.

## 2. Villa Cypris: la casa reale dietro la finzione

Indirizzo storico: avenue Douine, Roquebrune-Cap-Martin. La villa appartiene alla storia del dominio di Cap Martin, tra Mentone e Monaco. Pietra chiara, mattoni rossi, archi e decorazioni bizantine la distinguono dalle residenze più convenzionali del primo Novecento.

### Committenza e progettisti

Il Ministero della Cultura descrive una costruzione poco dopo il 1904 per Mme Robert Douine, moglie del direttore dei Grands Magasins du Louvre di Parigi. L'architetto è Édouard Arnaud. I giardini sono di Raffaële Maïnella, pittore e paesaggista nato a Benevento nel 1858.

### Un insieme protetto

L'iscrizione come monumento storico risale al 19 settembre 1990. Comprende edifici, cancelli, padiglioni, giardini, viali, scale, elementi d'acqua e ornamenti. Tutela l'insieme architettonico e paesaggistico, non crea un museo aperto al pubblico.

## 2. Villa Cypris: справжня будівля за вигаданою резиденцією

Історична адреса: avenue Douine, Roquebrune-Cap-Martin. Вілла належить до історії маєтків Cap Martin між Ментоном і Монако. Світлий камінь, червона цегла, арки й візантійські мотиви відрізняють її від звичніших резиденцій початку XX століття.

### Замовниця й автори

Міністерство культури описує будівництво невдовзі після 1904 року для пані Робер Дуїн, дружини директора паризьких Grands Magasins du Louvre. Архітектор — Едуар Арно, сади створив Раффаеле Майєлла, художник і ландшафтний майстер, народжений у Беневенто 1858 року.

### Охоронюваний ансамбль

До історичних пам'яток маєток внесено 19 вересня 1990 року. Охорона охоплює будівлі, брами, павільйони, сад, алеї, сходи, водойми й історичні прикраси. Це визнання ансамблю, не перетворення на громадський музей.

## 3. What role does Villa Cypris play in Mortelle Randonnée?

The regional tourism authority identifies Villa Cypris as a filming location for Mortelle Randonnée.

Further location research associates it with the villa of Ralph Forbes, played by Sami Frey.

Forbes is a character whose personal circumstances become connected with the detective's pursuit of the mysterious woman.

The villa provides a distinctive setting for part of that story.

### Which scenes were filmed here?

Published filming-location research identifies several sequences associated with Villa Cypris:

- Scenes involving Ralph Forbes's residence.

- Interior sequences involving L'Œil, the detective played by Michel Serrault.

- A sequence featuring the gallery overlooking the sea.

- A scene associated with an underground drainage or passage environment.

These identifications appear in the specialist L2TC location catalogue.

However, the catalogue's individual scene entries are community-contributed, and a complete comparison with the film's available versions has not yet been performed for this article.

Consequently, the villa itself is a confirmed filming location, while exact camera positions and some interior identifications require additional verification.

### Why does the house work so well on screen?

Its appearance is almost theatrical.

A decorative gallery stands above the rocks.

Arched openings frame the Mediterranean.

Dense vegetation partly conceals the buildings.

The property combines extraordinary beauty with an atmosphere of separation from the outside world.

In a psychological thriller, such a setting can become ambiguous.

Is the house a refuge?

A private sanctuary?

Or a place where dangerous relationships are hidden behind beautiful architecture?

The film makes good use of that uncertainty.

## 3. Quel rôle joue Cypris dans le film ?

Le comité régional de tourisme identifie Villa Cypris comme décor de Mortelle Randonnée. Le catalogue spécialisé L2TC l'associe à la résidence du personnage joué par Sami Frey, Ralph Forbes dans le récit. Cette précision scénique n'a pas le même degré de confirmation que le lieu de tournage lui-même.

### Les scènes attribuées au domaine

L2TC mentionne la résidence, des intérieurs avec L'Œil, la galerie surplombant la mer et un environnement de passage ou d'égout. Ces entrées sont dues à des internautes. Elles orientent une recherche, mais ne constituent pas un dossier de production ni une vérification complète des cadrages.

Nous distinguons donc le lieu de tournage documenté des angles de caméra et intérieurs encore à vérifier. Pas de minutages prétendument exacts, ni de promesse de retrouver une scène depuis l'espace public.

### Pourquoi cette demeure fonctionne-t-elle comme décor ?

Les arcades cadrent la Méditerranée, la végétation dissimule partiellement la propriété, la galerie domine les rochers. La beauté se combine avec une impression de retrait. Refuge, sanctuaire ou monde fermé : cette ambiguïté nourrit une lecture du décor, sans faire de la fiction l'histoire réelle des occupants.
it:
## 3. Quale ruolo ha Cypris nel film?

L'ente turistico regionale identifica Cypris come location di Mortelle Randonnée. Il catalogo specialistico L2TC la associa alla residenza del personaggio interpretato da Sami Frey, Ralph Forbes nella storia. Il dettaglio della scena ha un grado di conferma diverso dal luogo di ripresa stesso.

### Le scene attribuite alla villa

L2TC cita la residenza, interni con L'Œil, la galleria sul mare e un ambiente di passaggio o fognatura. Sono segnalazioni di utenti, utili per una ricerca ma non equivalenti a documentazione di produzione.

La villa è quindi un luogo documentato, mentre inquadrature, interni e minutaggi esatti restano da controllare. Non promettiamo di ritrovare una scena precisa da un punto pubblico.

### Perché funziona come ambiente narrativo?

Gli archi incorniciano il Mediterraneo, la vegetazione nasconde parte della casa, la galleria domina gli scogli. La bellezza convive con il distacco. Rifugio, santuario o spazio chiuso: è una possibile lettura del luogo, non la storia reale dei suoi abitanti.

## 3. Яку роль Cypris відіграє у фільмі?

Регіональна туристична організація називає віллу локацією Mortelle Randonnée. Спеціалізований каталог L2TC пов'язує її з резиденцією персонажа Самі Фрея, Ральфа Форбса в сюжеті. Точність сцени має інший рівень підтвердження, ніж сама участь будівлі у зйомках.

### Які сцени їй приписують?

L2TC згадує резиденцію, інтер'єри з L'Œil, галерею над морем і середовище підземного проходу чи каналізації. Це дописи користувачів, корисні для пошуку, але не виробниче досьє.

Отже, локація документована, а точні ракурси, інтер'єри й таймкоди ще потребують перевірки. Ми не обіцяємо знайти конкретний кадр із громадської точки.

### Чому місце виразне на екрані?

Арки обрамляють море, рослинність частково ховає будинок, галерея стоїть над скелями. Краса поєднується з відокремленістю. Притулок чи замкнений світ — можливе прочитання декорації, не реальна історія мешканців.

## 4. The most recognisable architectural feature: the seaside gallery

The coastal gallery is one of Villa Cypris's defining architectural elements.

It projects above the rocky shoreline, combining a stone base with warm brickwork and arched openings.

Its design has decorative affinities with Byzantine and Mediterranean architecture.

From the sea-facing side, the structure appears almost like a small pavilion suspended above the water.

### Why is the gallery important?

The Ministry of Culture describes the garden's main descending perspective as leading towards a covered colonnade silhouetted against the sea.

This is a carefully designed visual effect.

The visitor's eye is guided down through the property towards an architectural feature that frames the Mediterranean.

The relationship between garden design and sea view was intentional.

### Architecture becomes cinematography

This arrangement makes the villa particularly useful to filmmakers.

Arches provide strong visual frames.

The rocky coast creates a dramatic change in elevation.

The sea introduces brightness and movement beyond the still architecture.

And the contrast between enclosed spaces and open views can be used to suggest separation, freedom or vulnerability.

It is an ideal location for a film in which appearances and private emotions are constantly at odds.

## 4. La galerie maritime, élément le plus reconnaissable

La galerie associe soubassement de pierre, brique et ouvertures cintrées au-dessus du rivage. Son rapport à la mer compte autant que ses détails décoratifs.

### Une perspective volontaire

La notice du ministère décrit une perspective descendant depuis la maison vers une colonnade couverte détachée sur la mer. Ce n'est pas un heureux hasard : le jardin et l'architecture organisent le regard.

### Quand l'architecture suggère un cadrage

Les arcs fournissent des cadres, les rochers un changement de niveau, la mer de la lumière et du mouvement. Le contraste entre espaces clos et horizon ouvert peut évoquer isolement ou vulnérabilité. Ce sont des pistes d'interprétation, non l'identification vérifiée d'un plan particulier.
it:
## 4. La galleria sul mare

Basamento in pietra, mattoni e aperture ad arco si dispongono sopra la costa. Il rapporto con l'acqua è importante quanto il decoro.

### Una prospettiva progettata

La scheda ministeriale descrive un asse discendente dalla casa verso un colonnato coperto che si staglia sul mare. Giardino e architettura organizzano intenzionalmente lo sguardo.

### Architettura come possibile inquadratura

Gli archi offrono cornici, gli scogli dislivello, il mare luce e movimento. Il contrasto fra ambienti chiusi e orizzonte aperto può suggerire isolamento o vulnerabilità. Sono interpretazioni, non l'identificazione verificata di un singolo fotogramma.

## 4. Морська галерея — найупізнаваніший елемент

Кам'яна основа, цегла й аркові отвори здіймаються над берегом. Зв'язок із морем важливий не менше за декор.

### Навмисно створена перспектива

Міністерська довідка описує вісь, що спускається від будинку до критої колонади на тлі моря. Сад і архітектура цілеспрямовано організовують погляд.

### Архітектура як можливе кадрування

Арки дають рамки, скелі — перепад висоти, море — світло й рух. Контраст замкненого простору та горизонту може навіювати ізоляцію або вразливість. Це інтерпретації, не перевірене визначення окремого кадру.

## 5. The garden that mixed Mediterranean and Byzantine influences

Villa Cypris isn't simply an interesting house.

Its gardens are an important part of the original architectural project.

Raffaële Maïnella designed a landscape that combined formal structure with decorative references to several cultural traditions.

Among the documented features is a pergola supported by sixteen marble pillars and brick arches.

The French heritage description compares the effect with a ruined mosque.

Other features include garden passages, ornamental water structures, sculptures and terraced compositions.

### A designed world rather than a natural wilderness

The property may appear lush and spontaneous, but its landscape was deliberately organised.

The owner and designers sought to create a sequence of architectural experiences.

Passages lead from one setting to another.

Arches mark transitions.

Water and vegetation create contrasts.

The Mediterranean provides a distant background.

### Why that matters for film

A director doesn't always need to construct an elaborate set when a historic villa already offers strong architectural compositions.

Cypris contains real visual contrasts that can support suspense.

But the film's fictional story should not be confused with the original family's history.

The property's architecture and gardens existed long before Claude Miller arrived.

The characters and their actions belong to cinema.

## 5. Un jardin méditerranéen aux références byzantines

Le paysage fait partie du projet. Maïnella compose des passages, terrasses, ornements et structures d'eau. La notice patrimoniale décrit notamment une pergola de seize piliers de marbre portant des arcs de brique, avec une comparaison à une mosquée en ruine.

### Un monde composé

Le foisonnement végétal peut sembler spontané, mais l'organisation est délibérée. Passages, arcs et perspectives conduisent d'un espace à un autre ; la mer devient un arrière-plan.

### Le jardin n'est pas l'intrigue

Un décor réel peut fournir au cinéma ses contrastes sans construction de plateau. Mais les personnages, leurs intentions et leurs actes appartiennent au film. Le domaine existait bien avant le tournage : son histoire ne doit pas se confondre avec celle du thriller.

## 5. Un giardino mediterraneo con richiami bizantini

Il paesaggio è parte del progetto di Maïnella: passaggi, terrazze, ornamenti e strutture d'acqua. La descrizione patrimoniale cita una pergola di sedici pilastri di marmo con archi in mattoni, paragonata a una moschea in rovina.

### Un mondo composto

La vegetazione può sembrare spontanea, ma i percorsi e le prospettive sono organizzati. Gli archi segnano passaggi, la luce e l'acqua creano contrasti, il Mediterraneo diventa sfondo.

### Il giardino non è la trama

Un luogo reale può fornire contrasti cinematografici senza costruire un set. Ma personaggi e azioni appartengono alla finzione. Il dominio esisteva prima delle riprese: la sua storia non coincide con il thriller.

## 5. Середземноморський сад із візантійськими мотивами

Ландшафт — частина задуму Майєлли: переходи, тераси, прикраси й водні споруди. Пам'яткоохоронний опис згадує перголу з шістнадцятьма мармуровими опорами та цегляними арками, порівнюючи її зі зруйнованою мечеттю.

Рослинність здається довільною, але маршрути й перспективи спроєктовані. Арки позначають переходи, вода й світло створюють контрасти, море стає тлом.

### Сад не є сюжетом

Реальний ансамбль дає кінематографічні контрасти без спорудження декорацій. Проте персонажі й дії належать вигадці. Маєток існував до зйомок; його історія не тотожна історії трилера.

## 6. Can visitors enter Villa Cypris?

Villa Cypris remains private property.

The heritage record concerns a private estate; no regular ticketed public interior or garden visiting programme was verified during this research.

The fact that the building is a registered historic monument doesn't imply general public access.

### What is not permitted without authorisation?

Entering the private garden, following driveways towards the house, approaching residential entrances or attempting to access the historic gallery from inside the estate.

A closed gate is not an invitation to investigate.

Visitors should also avoid flying drones over private residential areas without appropriate permissions.

### What can you see legitimately?

Unlike many hidden Riviera villas, Cypris has an architectural relationship with the public coastal path.

The officially described Sentier du Littoral passes beside the villa's distinctive gallery.

That creates an opportunity to appreciate part of the real architecture without entering the estate.

The exact amount visible will depend on vegetation, route conditions and any temporary closures.

La propriété est privée. Aucune visite publique régulière des intérieurs ou du jardin n'a été vérifiée. L'inscription patrimoniale n'accorde pas un droit d'entrée.

### Ce qui ne fait pas partie de la promenade

N'entrez pas dans les jardins, les allées résidentielles ou les accès de la maison pour rejoindre la galerie. Respectez portails et panneaux. Ne faites pas voler de drone au-dessus du domaine en supposant que l'intérêt architectural vaut autorisation ; vérifiez les règles et permissions applicables.

## 7. A safe filming-location visit on the Sentier du Littoral

The Sentier Le Corbusier, also known as the Cap Martin coastal path, follows the rocky shoreline of the peninsula.

The regional tourism route describes 4.7 km one way from Carnolès towards Roquebrune-Cap-Martin station. A separate tourist-office sheet describes an approximately five-kilometre coastal outing. These are different route descriptions, not a guaranteed short return walk to the villa.

One of the features encountered along the route is the gallery of Villa Cypris.

This is the most useful visitor connection for the film.

### Where should you begin?

For visitors based in Menton, a practical starting point is the Carnolès side of Cap Martin, subject to current path access.

The regional tourism route describes an approach from Carnolès towards Avenue Winston Churchill and the coastline.

From there, the public coastal trail continues around the peninsula. Carnolès is a possible starting area, not a promise that your train stops there: check the dated outward and return services. SNCF also announces Nice–Ventimiglia night works from 22:00 to 06:00 Sunday–Thursday nights through 10 December 2027; favour a daylight outing rather than relying on a late train.

### What to expect

The route follows a rocky coast.

It includes areas of shade beneath trees and more exposed sections overlooking the sea.

Although the tourist office describes the path as relatively manageable, it is not a completely flat paved promenade.

Wear appropriate shoes and allow for uneven surfaces and steps.

### Finding the villa's gallery

Follow the authorised public coastal trail.

The published route description specifically identifies the pergola or gallery of Villa Cypris as a landmark along the path.

You may see the brick arches and decorative structure as you pass.

It's important to remember that the architectural feature belongs to the private estate even when viewed from a public right of way.

Stay on the designated path. Do not leave it to enter the property or obtain a closer photograph.

### How long does it take?

Allow approximately 45–90 minutes for a shorter coastal outing, depending on the chosen start, your pace and the time spent stopping.

This is an editorial estimate, not a field-measured walking time from a specific railway station to the gallery.

For the complete coastal trail, allow a longer outing and confirm your return transport.

### Weather and closures

The tourist-office sheet describes free access subject to favourable weather, not a live confirmation that every section is open. No date-specific opening guarantee was established for the Cypris section on 4 November 2026. Check municipal notices and on-site signs before setting out.

Sections may close during dangerous weather, high seas, rockfall risk or maintenance works.

Do not bypass barriers.

If the route is closed, postpone the filming-location visit rather than attempting to reach the gallery from private roads.

## 7. Une sortie prudente sur le sentier du littoral

La promenade Le Corbusier longe les rochers du Cap Martin. Le descriptif régional donne 4,7 km en aller simple entre Carnolès et la gare de Roquebrune-Cap-Martin. Une autre fiche touristique décrit environ cinq kilomètres. Ce sont des descriptions de parcours, pas une durée garantie d'aller-retour jusqu'à la galerie.

### Où commencer ?

Depuis Menton, le secteur de Carnolès est une possibilité si le tronçon est ouvert. Le parcours officiel rejoint le bord de mer et l'avenue Winston Churchill avant de contourner le cap. Vérifiez le train aller et retour : un départ conseillé près de Carnolès n'assure pas que votre train y marque l'arrêt.

SNCF annonce des travaux Nice–Vintimille de 22 h à 6 h les nuits du dimanche au jeudi jusqu'au 10 décembre 2027. Privilégiez une sortie de jour plutôt qu'un retour tardif supposé.

### Terrain et observation

Attendez-vous à des marches et des surfaces irrégulières, des parties ombragées et d'autres exposées. Ce n'est pas une promenade entièrement plane et goudronnée. Portez des chaussures adaptées ; ne présentez pas l'ensemble comme accessible sans marches.

Suivez le tracé public balisé. Le descriptif signale la pergola de Cypris après la pointe. Observez arcs et relation au rivage sans quitter le chemin pour une photo plus proche.

### Durée et fermetures

Prévoyez 45–90 minutes pour une courte portion choisie selon votre départ et votre rythme : c'est une estimation éditoriale, pas un temps mesuré entre une gare et la villa. Le parcours complet exige plus de temps et un retour vérifié.

La fiche touristique indique la gratuité sous réserve de météo favorable, pas une ouverture en temps réel. Le tronçon de Cypris n'a pas fait l'objet d'une confirmation datée d'ouverture au 4 novembre 2026. Consultez avis municipaux et panneaux sur place. Mer forte, intempéries, chutes de pierres ou travaux peuvent fermer une section. Ne contournez jamais une barrière et ne cherchez pas de détour par le domaine privé.

La promenade Le Corbusier segue gli scogli del Cap Martin. 45–90 minuti sono un margine editoriale per un tratto breve scelto secondo partenza e passo, non un tempo misurato dalla stazione alla galleria. Il percorso intero richiede più tempo e ritorno confermato.

## 8. What should you compare with the film?

A strong filming-location visit doesn't require reproducing the fictional character's movements.

It requires identifying architectural features that survive.

### The gallery and arches

Look at the proportions of the brick arcades and their relationship with the sea.

If you're comparing the film with a modern photograph, architectural geometry is more dependable than vegetation or surface colour.

### The stone base

The gallery's substantial stone structure and relationship with the coastal rocks help establish its position.

### The surrounding landscape

Notice the contrast between the enclosed property and the sea beyond.

This relationship is part of the original design and a significant reason why the villa works cinematically.

### What still needs verification?

Exact timestamps, camera angles and which portions of the film's interior scenes were recorded within Cypris rather than elsewhere.

A reliable Then & Now comparison should use a legitimately sourced frame from the same film edition and a modern photograph taken from an authorised public position.

## 8. Que comparer avec le film ?

Une visite n'exige pas de reproduire les déplacements d'un personnage. Comparez plutôt les éléments architecturaux qui subsistent.

### Arcs, soubassement et paysage

Les proportions des arcades et leur rapport à la mer sont plus fiables que la couleur des murs ou la végétation. Le socle de pierre et les rochers aident à comprendre l'implantation. Regardez aussi le contraste entre propriété close et horizon.

### Ce qui reste à vérifier

Minutages, positions de caméra et répartition des intérieurs entre Cypris et d'autres décors demandent un travail supplémentaire. Un vrai comparatif avant/après utiliserait une image obtenue légitimement de la même édition du film et une photographie prise depuis un emplacement public autorisé. Aucune reconstruction de scène n'est présentée ici comme preuve.

## 8. Cosa confrontare con il film?

Non serve riprodurre i movimenti dei personaggi. Cercate elementi architettonici rimasti riconoscibili.

### Archi, base e paesaggio

Le proporzioni delle arcate rispetto al mare sono più affidabili di vegetazione e colori. Il basamento in pietra e gli scogli aiutano a capire la posizione; osservate il rapporto tra proprietà chiusa e orizzonte.

### Cosa richiede ancora verifica?

Minutaggi, posizioni di camera e attribuzione degli interni a Cypris o altri set richiedono altro lavoro. Un confronto prima/dopo serio userebbe un fotogramma ottenuto legittimamente dalla stessa edizione e una foto da un punto pubblico autorizzato. Qui nessuna ricostruzione è presentata come prova.

## 8. Що порівнювати з фільмом?

Не потрібно повторювати рухи персонажів. Шукайте збережені архітектурні елементи.

### Арки, основа й ландшафт

Пропорції аркад щодо моря надійніші за колір чи рослинність. Кам'яна основа й скелі пояснюють розташування. Звертайте увагу на контраст закритого маєтку та горизонту.

### Що ще потребує перевірки?

Таймкоди, положення камери й розподіл інтер'єрів між Cypris та іншими місцями вимагають додаткової роботи. Надійне порівняння «тоді й тепер» потребує законно отриманого кадру з тієї самої версії й сучасного фото з дозволеної громадської точки. Жодна реконструкція тут не подається як доказ.

## 9. Why the Riviera looks different in Mortelle Randonnée

Many films use the French Riviera as shorthand for pleasure.

The sun, gardens and beautiful villas imply freedom and luxury.

Mortelle Randonnée uses those familiar elements for a more unsettling purpose.

The settings are beautiful, but the characters are often isolated.

Wealth and elegant surroundings don't guarantee safety.

The detective moves through a world where outward appearances provide little information about private intentions.

### The detective's gaze

L'Œil spends much of the film observing other people.

His job requires distance.

But his emotional identification with the young woman makes objectivity increasingly difficult.

That tension between looking and understanding is reflected in the film's use of locations.

A spectacular villa may look comprehensible from the outside.

But the life taking place within it remains hidden.

### Villa Cypris as an architectural metaphor

The house's grand exterior and elaborate garden create an impression of order.

Its rooms, paths and partially enclosed structures also suggest privacy.

For a story about unreliable identity and emotional projection, those qualities become particularly powerful.

The setting is not merely attractive.

It helps express the film's central psychological concerns.
fr:
## 9. La Riviera autrement que comme promesse de plaisir

Soleil, villas et jardins servent souvent à évoquer liberté et luxe. Dans une lecture de Mortelle Randonnée, la beauté des lieux contraste avec l'isolement des personnages. La richesse n'assure pas la sécurité, et les apparences disent peu des intentions.

### Le regard du détective

L'Œil devrait garder sa distance professionnelle. Son identification affective la rend de plus en plus fragile. Regarder n'est pas comprendre : une façade spectaculaire ne révèle pas la vie qu'elle abrite.

### Une métaphore architecturale

L'ordre de la composition et l'intimité des espaces donnent matière à cette interprétation. Cypris n'est pas seulement une belle adresse ; son décor peut évoquer le décalage entre ce qui est montré et ce qui est caché. Il s'agit d'une lecture éditoriale, pas d'un commentaire attesté du réalisateur.
it:
## 9. Una Riviera diversa dalla promessa di piacere

Sole, ville e giardini spesso evocano libertà e lusso. Una lettura di Mortelle Randonnée vede invece la bellezza in contrasto con l'isolamento. La ricchezza non garantisce sicurezza, le apparenze non chiariscono le intenzioni.

### Lo sguardo del detective

L'Œil dovrebbe mantenere distanza professionale; l'identificazione emotiva la indebolisce. Guardare non significa comprendere: una facciata spettacolare non rivela la vita interna.

### Una metafora architettonica

L'ordine della composizione e la privacy degli spazi sostengono questa interpretazione. Il dominio può evocare la differenza fra ciò che si mostra e ciò che si nasconde. È una lettura editoriale, non una dichiarazione verificata del regista.
uk:
## 9. Рив'єра не лише як обіцянка задоволення

Сонце, сади й вілли часто означають свободу та розкіш. У нашому прочитанні Mortelle Randonnée краса контрастує з ізоляцією. Багатство не гарантує безпеки, зовнішність мало говорить про наміри.

### Погляд детектива

L'Œil мав би тримати професійну дистанцію, але емоційна ідентифікація її руйнує. Дивитися не означає розуміти: ефектний фасад не відкриває життя всередині.

### Архітектурна метафора

Упорядкованість композиції та приватність просторів підтримують таке тлумачення. Маєток може нагадувати про різницю між показаним і прихованим. Це редакційне прочитання, не підтверджений коментар режисера.

## 10. A useful comparison: Villa Torre Clementina

Cap Martin has another extraordinary filming location nearby.

Villa Torre Clementina appears in René Clément's Les Félins (Joy House, 1964), starring Alain Delon and Jane Fonda.

Both villas belong to the luxurious residential history of Cap Martin.

Both use elaborate decorative architecture.

Both were developed in the early twentieth century.

And both were chosen for psychological thrillers in which magnificent private homes conceal troubled relationships.

But they are separate properties with different histories.

Another published filming-location catalogue identifies Villa Ephrussi de Rothschild in Saint-Jean-Cap-Ferrat as a location used in Mortelle Randonnée.

### Why mention it?

It offers an interesting contrast with Villa Cypris.

Villa Ephrussi is a public museum and historic garden with ordinary admission arrangements.

Check its official access page and exceptional closures, including the announced closure on 14 December 2026. No admission is included in this guide.

Cypris is private.

Both have spectacular architecture and gardens, but their visitor access is completely different.

### Should you combine them in a single outing?

Saint-Jean-Cap-Ferrat lies west of Monaco, while Villa Cypris is on Cap Martin.

For a normal visitor, travelling between them adds time and transport complexity.

It's better to treat Ephrussi as a separate optional filming-location excursion, not part of a short Cypris walk.

## 12. A compact visitor plan from Menton

### The essential experience

Travel towards the Cap Martin coastal area.

Check that the relevant section of the Sentier du Littoral is open.

Walk along the marked path towards the Villa Cypris gallery, following the official trail description.

Observe the seaside architecture from the public route.

Continue only as far as you're comfortable, then return or use a confirmed onward connection.

This gives you the strongest combination of cinematic interest and practical accessibility.

### If you're interested mainly in architecture

Spend longer examining the relationship between the historic villas and the landscape.

The coastal path offers a different view of Cap Martin from the inland roads.

The buildings are often partly hidden behind vegetation, which helps explain why privacy was such an important part of the estate designs.

### If you're interested mainly in the film

Watch Mortelle Randonnée before your visit.

Pay attention to the villa sequences involving Ralph Forbes.

Then compare the architecture with the public views of the real property.

Do not assume that every filmed interior remains accessible or unchanged.

### If the path is closed

Choose another public coastal walk and postpone the Cypris-specific visit.

There is no reason to enter private land or approach the property through an unsafe access point.

## 13. Is this location worth visiting without seeing the film?

Yes, particularly for visitors interested in architecture.

Villa Cypris is significant independently of Claude Miller's thriller.

Its Byzantine-inspired design, coastal gallery and historic gardens form part of Cap Martin's architectural heritage.

The film provides an additional layer of meaning.

It shows how a real private residence can become a fictional psychological environment.

But the history of the building belongs to more than one production.

An architect designed it.

A landscape artist shaped the gardens.

An owner commissioned it.

Later generations adapted and maintained it.

Then the cameras arrived.

The film is one chapter in a longer story.

## 13. Cela vaut-il la peine sans avoir vu le film ?

Oui pour qui aime l'architecture. La demeure, sa galerie et ses jardins ont une histoire propre, antérieure au cinéma. Le film ajoute une strate : un lieu réel devient un espace psychologique fictif.

L'architecte, le paysagiste et la commanditaire ont façonné le domaine avant l'arrivée des caméras. Le tournage est un chapitre de cette histoire, pas sa totalité. On peut s'intéresser au bâtiment sans transformer les actions des personnages en faits historiques.

## Frequently asked questions

### Was Mortelle Randonnée filmed at Villa Cypris?

Yes. The regional Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur tourism authority identifies Villa Cypris as a filming location for Claude Miller's 1983 film.

### What does Villa Cypris represent in the film?

It is identified in filming-location records as the villa of Ralph Forbes, played by Sami Frey.

### Which scenes were filmed there?

Specialist location records associate Cypris with sequences involving Forbes's residence, the detective and the seaside gallery. Exact shots and timestamps still need independent verification.

### Is Mortelle Randonnée the same as Deadly Circuit?

Yes. Mortelle Randonnée was distributed internationally under titles including Deadly Circuit and Deadly Run.

### Who directed the film?

Claude Miller, with a screenplay by Michel Audiard and Jacques Audiard based on Marc Behm's work.

### Who plays the detective?

Michel Serrault plays the private detective known as L'Œil, or “The Eye”.

### Who designed Villa Cypris?

Architect Édouard Arnaud. Its gardens were designed by Raffaële Maïnella.

### When was the villa built?

Shortly after 1904, when the private Cap Martin estate was subdivided.

### Can visitors enter Villa Cypris?

No regular public visiting programme was verified. It remains private property.

### Can you see the villa from a public path?

The official coastal walking route passes the villa's distinctive seaside gallery, subject to temporary path access restrictions.

### Is the coastal path suitable for wheelchairs?

The full coastal trail contains uneven terrain and steps. It should not be treated as a continuously step-free route.

### Is Villa Torre Clementina the same building?

No. Torre Clementina is another historic private villa on Cap Martin, associated with the 1964 film Les Félins.

### Can I visit both villas in one day?

Their histories can be explored together, but neither property offers confirmed regular public entry. Use authorised public routes and avoid assuming that all buildings will be clearly visible.

### Does the guide contain spoilers?

No major plot developments or the film's ending are revealed.

## Final thoughts: a darker story behind a beautiful façade

Villa Cypris is an extraordinary piece of Riviera architecture.

Its brick arcades, decorative details and seaside gallery belong to a world of private estates designed to be both beautiful and secluded.

In Mortelle Randonnée, that beauty becomes part of a much darker story.

Claude Miller uses the elegant environment to heighten the contrast between luxury and emotional instability.

The villa appears reassuring from a distance.

The lives unfolding within it are anything but simple.

For visitors to Cap Martin, the real building offers an unusual connection between cinema and architectural history.

You can appreciate its remarkable coastal gallery from the authorised public path, when open.

You can learn about the architect and landscape designer who created it.

And you can discover how a private residence became part of one of French cinema's most unsettling thrillers.

The film is fiction.

The building is real.

And the relationship between them is what makes Villa Cypris worth understanding.
fr:
## Une histoire sombre derrière une belle façade

La galerie, les arcades et le paysage de Cypris rappellent un monde de résidences belles et retirées. Le thriller donne à cette beauté une autre résonance. L'intérêt est dans le rapport entre un bâtiment réel et une fiction inquiétante, pas dans la recherche d'une entrée secrète.

Observez depuis le parcours public autorisé lorsqu'il est ouvert ; découvrez l'architecture et ses créateurs. Le film est une fiction, le bâtiment est réel, et cette distinction rend la visite plus intéressante.
it:
## Una storia inquietante dietro una bella facciata

Galleria, arcate e paesaggio ricordano residenze eleganti e appartate. Il thriller dà a quella bellezza un'altra risonanza. Il valore è nel rapporto tra luogo reale e finzione, non nella ricerca di un accesso segreto.

Osservate dal percorso pubblico autorizzato quando aperto e scoprite architettura e progettisti. Il film è finzione, l'edificio è reale: distinguerli rende la visita più interessante.

## Темна історія за красивим фасадом

Галерея, аркади й ландшафт нагадують світ красивих відокремлених резиденцій. Трилер надає красі іншого звучання. Інтерес — у зв'язку реального місця й вигадки, не в пошуку таємного входу.

Оглядайте з дозволеної громадської стежки, коли вона відкрита, дізнавайтеся про архітектуру та її авторів. Фільм — вигадка, будівля — реальність; це розрізнення робить прогулянку цікавішою.
